thread:
manu: Noticing an uptick in streaming sessions that terminate with partial payloads (206) across api-gateway and runtime between 03:40-04:05 UTC. Rough count ~900. Initial traces show abrupt FIN from runtime side during long-poll frames.

emma: Can you paste sample log lines and the regions? Any rate or load change?

manu: Samples: 
```
2026-04-11T03:42:12Z req=8f4a2 region=us-east status=206 emit_bytes=102 ERR=runtime:emit-failed; conn_close=write:broken pipe
2026-04-11T03:43:01Z req=8f4b7 region=ap-south status=206 emit_bytes=56 ERR=proxy:drain-triggered
```

ricardo: I saw a small bump in scale activity in us-east at 03:40 due to a sudden traffic spike. Might be instance preemption + immediate drain leading to incomplete stream flush.

ops-bot: INCIDENT_ALERT: #inc-2026-04-streaming-partial-wave (sev3)  responders: @manu @emma @ricardo

lia: Quick triage thought  ensure runtime attempts a graceful stream flush on drain with a configurable grace period; if flush times out, tag final event as `forced_partial` so downstream analytics can exclude expected truncations.

noah: I'll search for recent changes to gateway idle timeouts or connection pooling. Also check nginx vs envoy timeout misconfig.

emma: Proposed owners and SLAs: runtime flush behavior -> @manu (PR/qa 48h), gateway timeout alignment -> @noah (config change canary 24h), monitoring & alerts -> @lia (dashboard + weekly anomaly job). Thoughts?

manu: I can own runtime changes. Plan: add a drain hook that attempts a BestEffortFlush for up to 5s, then emit a final control frame `event: partial_finalized reason=drain_timeout` before closing. ETA: PR in 36h, canary 3/4 days after.

ricardo: For experiments we should also instrument per-stream state machine events (OPEN -> FIRST_EMIT -> LAST_EMIT -> DRAIN_NOTIFY -> CLOSE_REASON). That will help separate client-driven closes vs server drains. I'll add to trace schema.

lia: I'll create an alert that fires when partial_rate > 0.5% over 5m and correlate with kube.pod.eviction_count metric. Also add a weekly job that computes 90-day rolling partial_rate trend and emails eng on > 25% delta.

noah: Found an Envoy config mismatch: downstream idle timeout was 15s, upstream was 10s in one cluster. I'll align both to 30s for the canary pool and roll config with 5% of traffic first.

emma: Adding concrete action items to tracker now: 
A) runtime: add BestEffortFlush on drain + final control frame `partial_finalized`  owner:@manu  due: 2026-04-15
B) gateway: unify idle timeouts (upstream/downstream) to 30s for canary, run config roll  owner:@noah  due: 2026-04-13
C) traces: enrich streaming state transitions and final_close_reason tag  owner:@ricardo  due: 2026-04-17
D) monitoring: partial_rate alert + weekly trend job  owner:@lia  due: 2026-04-12
E) customer comms template for transient partials with mitigation steps (retries/backoff)  owner:@emma  due: 2026-04-14

manu: I'll include unit tests that simulate mid-stream preempt + flush success/fail and add integration run in staging that exercises 1k concurrent streams for 2h.

ridardo: (typo fix) ricardo: I'll also add a tag `drain_window_id` so we can join drain logs to traces easily.

noah: Rolling the timeout change to canary pool now. Observability: enabling `partial_emit_reason` and counting reasons over next 2h.

lia: Quick interim mitigation suggestion: return 429+Retry-After to clients that open > 50 short-lived streams per minute per API key to reduce client-driven reconnect amplification. We should document recommended client backoff (exponential with jitter).

emma: Good call. Add action: F) throttling short-lived reconnect loops at edge + doc update  owner:@lia/@emma  due: 2026-04-16

manu: Will follow up in the postmortem with reproduction artifacts and test results. Scheduling nightly test run to validate flush reliability.

emma: Sync scheduled Thu 15:30 UTC to review PRs and canary metrics. If partial_rate doesn't drop under 0.2% in canary after 6h, stop rollout and debug.

noah: Example grep for oncall to find candidate traces: 
```
jq -r '.entries[] | select(.status==206) | [.req,.region,.partial_emit_reason,.close_reason] | @tsv' streaming-traces.ndjson | rg "drain|timeout|emit"
```

lia: I'll update the runbook play with these grep commands and the immediate mitigation checklist.

manu: Thanks all. Posting postmortem link once initial edits are in.
